Gotta admit, I'm not a good hobbyist when it comes to my vaping. I have a few batteries that I use depending upon what outfit I'm wearing, and where I'm doing the vaping. For around the house I have a Tesla spider that keeps a good charge, and can be adjusted voltage wise. The tanks are pretty good. I have two of them. I also have two other batteries that are small and compact. I can keep them in my suit pocket or my jeans and feel alright about them.

For me, the big thing is the juice. I have a local smoke shop that I love going to. Tasty mixes, and the guy behind the counter is pretty good at recommending flavor blends for me. I have one blend for the morning (light and smooth), one for the afternoon (strong and sharp) and one for the evening with cocktails (strong rich and savory flavor, reminiscent of pipe tobacco).

I dunno. I enjoy it. It got me off thirty years (on and off) of cigarettes, and will probably add a good decade of life to me. Plus my clothes not smelling like smoking is pretty awesome.

I mostly use a kanger subtank or a lemo drop with a 30w variable volt/watt battery - I have two because I liked the size of the battery so much. (iStick and an athena 30s)

I also have a tesla spider stick battery with variable volts that I mostly use with a kanger genitank (it's basically a cheaper aerotank).

I still have my old cigalike brand that I keep for emergencies and whenever I need to be super sneaky about having a ecig on me.

The genitank and subtank have just a screw in atomizer head that is pretty simple because that's literally all you do. Screw it in and fill it up and then screw in the tank and get to your nicotine. The subtank has a dual option and I'd recommend it to anyone that is worried about rebuildables for that reason. It's a tank you can fuck your build up as much as you want and still be able to use because of the other coil.

The lemo and the subtank rebuildables parts are basically, fun. They both came with a coil and the subtank even has a replacement set of coils. It also has organic cotton in the box I got from them so you can start rebuilding right away. You'll fuck shit up probably the first couple of times but it's no big deal because the cotton and coils are dirt cheap for the quantities youll use.

So say I want a thick vapor for just chilling at home or if i'm going to go out somewhere it's acceptable to vape thick clouds. Use a build/coil that's lower ohms and have at it. If I want to be a little more discreet I can use the genitank and it doesnt produce as thick of vapor but it still hits nice and I can run a much higher nicotine in there than I can with either of the bigger tanks.

If you're transitioning from a cigalike/some of the screw in atomizer deals the subtank and tanks like it are pretty rough with the high nic content.
